title: Acta evidence entry (draft-farley-acta-signed-receipts-03, Section 4.1)
description: One entry of the OPTIONAL payload.evidence array. Structural only: whether an entry is independent corroboration is decided by the relying party under Section 4.3, never by this schema.

authority.description: The attesting party. Advisory: the producer controls it.

ref.description: A resolvable reference, or sha256:<hex> of the attested subject.

kid.description: The attesting authority's key id; the relying party obtains the key out of band.

alg.description: Signature algorithm; defaults to EdDSA when absent.

sig.description: The authority's signature over JCS({dimension, ref, state, as_of?}), lowercase hex. Length depends on alg.
